purpose: Verify the Equipment public admission boundary and route behavior after Stage 4-5 without reopening Equipment semantics or changing the frozen public population.

routes.detailParamSyntax: ASCII decimal digits only, then positive safe integer validation
routes.canonicalNavigation: List links emit String(record.equipmentId). QA does not introduce a new textual canonicalization rule beyond the existing route guard.
routes.publicResolution: After syntactic validation, only exact numeric equipmentId membership in the frozen general/exclusive public detail maps may resolve. Missing public membership must return the route not-found state.

admission.general: All 206 Stage 3-4 general detail IDs resolve as kind=general and no others are admitted through that set.
admission.exclusive: All 167 Stage 3-5 exclusive detail IDs resolve as kind=exclusive and no others are admitted through that set.
admission.hiddenSpecial: All 16 Stage 3-6 HIDDEN_SPECIAL IDs remain pageAdmission=false and must resolve null through the public detail loader.
admission.hold: equipmentId 2013 remains HOLD_UNRESOLVED_ACQUISITION, pageAdmission=false, and must resolve null through the public detail loader.
admission.unknownPositiveIds: Positive safe integers outside the canonical/public populations must resolve null through the public detail loader.

hardGates: General List and General Detail are exactly 206 unique IDs with exact set parity.
Exclusive List and Exclusive Detail are exactly 167 unique IDs with exact set parity.
General and Exclusive public sets are pairwise disjoint and union to exactly 373 public IDs.
The 16 hidden-special IDs and HOLD equipmentId 2013 are disjoint from all 373 public IDs.
General + Exclusive + Hidden Special + HOLD are pairwise disjoint and union to exactly 390 canonical IDs.
Every public general/exclusive ID resolves through readEquipmentDetailPageData with the expected kind.
Every hidden-special/HOLD ID and representative unknown positive safe integer resolves null through readEquipmentDetailPageData.
The detail route rejects non-digit, zero, negative, fractional, signed, scientific, whitespace-padded, non-finite text and unsafe integer inputs before public lookup.
The detail route has an explicit notFoundComponent and maps missing public loader data to notFound().
The generated route tree contains independent /equipment, /equipment/exclusive and /equipment/$equipmentId routes.
No Equipment page composition code imports Stage 3-6 special/unresolved data or raw ConfigData to widen public admission.
